name: StatusBadge
summary: A compact textual label for a state or category.

props.name: children
props.meaning: Visible text communicating the state or category.

props.name: tone
props.meaning: Defaults to neutral; accent emphasizes an enabled or current state without implying a global severity.

accessibility: Meaning is conveyed by visible text, never color alone. This is static text, not a live region or an interactive control.
usage: Use short text for enabled settings, current sessions and permission categories. Announce dynamic outcomes separately in the owning workflow.
